findings.title: Update the root-harness custody receipt for the changed asset allowlist
findings.body: The root-node custody guard hashes this `files` declaration and its enclosing line range. Its current stored recipe still expects the pre-change declaration, and the supplied guard evidence shows it now fails with `DOCUMENTATION_TOOL_NODE_ENTRY_CUSTODY_UNQUALIFIED ... reviewed defining operation changed files`. Consequently, the native/root documentation guard cannot run after this change. Include the corresponding reviewed-recipe successor (updated declaration hash, shifted function coordinates, range hash, and initialization receipt) with this allowlist update.

overall_explanation: The new allowlist entries are internally consistent, but the only submitted product change invalidates the repository's required root-harness custody receipt. The supplied successor metadata is explicitly proposed rather than included in this change bundle, so the existing guard deterministically rejects the updated library.
